QuestInfo.name: A Wrench in the Works
QuestInfo.0: Your mission to the Black Wings' hideout at the Power Plant is about the begin. Talk to #b#p2151000#, the Blaster Job Instructor#k to hear the details of the mission.
QuestInfo.1:
Energy from the power plant is being rerouted by the Black Wings from Edelstein to somewhere else. Your mission is to destroy the #r#o9001032##k. The plan is as follows:

1. Sneak into the mine disguised as a Black Wing. 
2. Enter the generator room in #b#m310050100##k.
3. Get rid of #r#o9001032##k and return.

It's not an easy task but it's not impossible if the plan is followed step by step. All right, it's go-time.

#o9001032##r #a230331##k

* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: Destroying the #o9001032# alleviated much of the power outages plaguing Edelstein. #p2151000# said that you proved yourself capable and authorized your Job Advancement.

0.0: I hope you're ready, kiddo. This mission is... more complicated than most. You know the Power Plant and the Mine outside town? They rightfully belong to the citizens of Edelstein, but the Black Wings have taken them over for their own purposes. They aren't even letting citizens enter!
0.1: The Black Wings took control of the Power Plant before anyone realized what had happened and started redirecting the energy elsewhere. It wasn't until the rolling blackouts started that we noticed something was wrong.
0.2: The Black Wings have built a huge #r#o9001032##k at the Power Plant to capture and redirect the town's energy elsewhere. I don't know what their plan is, but it can't be good.
0.3: I'm sure you can tell where I'm going with this. Head to the #bGenerator Room at the Power Plant#k and destroy the #o9001032#. You'll only get one shot at this, so time is a factor. I'm also afraid we're gonna have to send you in without backup.
0.4: The Power Plant is essential to the livelihood of the citizens of Edelstein, so we can't just go in Arm Cannons blazing and risk damaging the place.  If the Power Plant were to blow up, it would take out all of Edelstein with it...
0.5: The Black Wings know exactly what they are doing... They're holding us hostage with our own Power Plant. If we don't do exactly as they all say, there'll be a crater where Edelstein used to be. The city's leadership had no choice but to give the Black Wings full control of Edelstein.
0.6: This mission will be one of the most difficult we've ever given any of our operatives. I'll understand if you want to back out... but this is an opportunity to strike a serious blow to those jerks holding our city for ransom. The well-being of all Edelstein rests firmly upon your shoulders. Will you help us?

yes.0: Good. Now look, infiltrating the Power Plant won't be an easy feat. The whole place is crawling with Black Wing agents. But you've got to find a way! I think that Stephan may be able to help you. If you can #bdisguise yourself as a Black Wing#k, you won't have to fight your way in.
yes.1: #bDisguise yourself as a Black Wing to gain access to the Power Room and destroy the #o9001032#, all with a limited amount of time.#k It is as difficult as it sounds, but I believe in you. I await your return.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Look kid, I don't blame you for being scared. Heck, I am too. Maybe after you've done a little training you'll change your mind about helping us.

mob.0:
You haven't destroyed the #r#o9001032##k yet? I'm not expecting any miracles, but you've got to try! Start by looking for a way to disguise yourself as a Black Wing.

#b* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
